lines.text: Many learners say: Where you are going?
In a question, put are before you.
Are you! Where are you from?

data.why: In a question, put are before you.

native.tip: في السؤال نضع الفعل قبل الفاعل: “Where are you going?” وليس “Where you are going?”
native.caption: هل تسأل “Where you are going?” 🙈 في الإنجليزية يأتي الفعل are قبل you في السؤال: “Where are you going?” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر معه! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “are you”. تذكّر: الفعل قبل الفاعل في السؤال. اختبار مجاني هنا: {link}

en.tip: In a question, the verb comes before the subject: “Where are you going?” not “Where you are going?”
en.caption: Do you ask “Where you are going?” 🙈 In English, are comes before you in a question: “Where are you going?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
